cases.title: Repository setup identity and commit hook
cases.description: Verify the required identity and attribution controls before implementation.
steps_to_reproduce: Check Git author and committer identity and core.hooksPath.
Check hook syntax and executable permission.
Run the hook on a temporary message containing attribution and with incorrect author/committer identities.
cases.expected_result: Required owner identity; attribution removed; incorrect identities rejected; initial commit contains only the requested message.
cases.environment: Local macOS, Git CLI; Codex CLI 0.163.0

attempts.actual_result: All setup checks passed; initial commit 9ec3283 has required author and committer with no attribution.
attempts.note: Temporary hook fixtures were confined to .git and removed. No application tests exist yet.
